releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- NomaiVR compatibility work from @theCapypara :
	- A "Show Unlock Notification" setting that shows a text notification at the center of the screen whenever an item is unlocked. This is primarily intended for NomaiVR players, since the normal in-game console is difficult to read in VR.
	- Normally NomaiVR forces you to wake up facing GD, just like when you wake up in the vanilla game. The randomizer will now actively disable this "feature", since it becomes a bug when the randomizer puts you on another planet or randomizes orbits.
	- Reimplements the in-game console to follow the player's view while fixing several cases where it would fail to appear.
	- Extend NomaiVR's solution for text input fields in the main menu to also work for the in-game console.
	- Fixes NomaiVR's handling of the Translator and Signalscope, especially when ArchipelagoRandomizer prevents you from equipping them.
	- Fixes NomaiVR re-enabling the Landing Camera after ArchipelagoRandomizer disables it.
	- Edits NomaiVR's ship UI to say when the Signalscope, Scout, and Landing Camera are "not available".
- Song of the Universe tracking fixes:
	- Fixed Universal Tracker "Go Mode" for Song of the Universe goals
	- Fixed an in-game tracker bug that would cause inconsistently crashes on Song of the Universe slots

releases.name: v1.2.2
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- @RS_Mind attempted to work around a Forgotten Castaways bug where the "Recursive Node" sometimes doesn't spawn. It's too inconsistent for anyone to pin down exact causes, but we suspect having many other mods loaded makes it more likely, which would explain why only randomizer players seem to be reporting it.
- Logic fixes:
	- Since you can't carry both a DLC Artifact and the Echo Hike Threader at the same time, Starlit Cove is no longer in logic if the Threader is your only logical way of reaching Cinder Isles (fixes #98 ).
	- Added an explicit "Hearth's Neighbor Museum Plate" region to the HN1 logic to help remind players how to unlock the warp to the HN1 system
	- Suitless logic for the text wheel inside the Frozen Shuttle now requires Spacesuit
	- "DW: Starlit Cove Upper Tower Floors" logic is now aware that Raft Docks Patch is an alternative to Dream Totem Patch
- "Find Gabbro's Ship" location is no longer incorrectly triggered by the ship on Bracket's Rest in FQ.
- Fix Nomai text coloring exception spam on unscouted locations (the feature is still unsupported/broken, but this quick fix reduces the odds of it breaking unrelated stuff)

releases.name: v1.2.1
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- [Updated the Archipelago.MultiClient.Net library to v6.7.1](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1043855558303821844/1484975530968354966). The change most likely to affect players is Berserker's "[Request Datapackage as individual responses](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago.MultiClient.Net/pull/135)", which should help prevent timeout errors when connecting to large multiworlds.
- Forgotten Castaways logic fixes from @msyverw:
	- The "Deep Bramble via Warp Drive" region now logically connects to the (shipless) "Deep Bramble" region, which fixes some cases where the early parts of FC were incorrectly out of logic
	- Tweaked the regions of "DB Ship Log: Stranded Nomai 5 - Warp" and "FC Ship Log: Bramble's Doorstep 2 - Nomai" so that they won't be in logic until you have logical access to *both* systems, since you can't get a ship log fact for the system you aren't in
	- In-game tracker now uses the correct logic region for Deep Bramble spawns
	- The connection from a Deep Bramble spawn to the "Deep Bramble via Warp Drive" region now logically requires only Launch Codes, not Deep Bramble Coordinates as it accidentally used to
	- "FC Ship Log: Pillar Town 2 - Gift" now logically requires the Expanded Dictionary
- Fixed suitless logic by making Nomai shuttle locations require Spacesuit to reach via gravity cannon recalls. Some time ago a base game patch made it no longer possible to move Nomai orbs from inside the ship, which is a problem for suitless players. The only logic this actually broke was entering a Nomai shuttle by recalling it to the corresponding gravity cannon, since you would suffocate while moving the orb to recall it.

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- New `song_of_the_universe` goal and `required_friends` option (thanks @msyverw). This goal requires meeting a certain number of "friends" before going to the Eye. For example, if you enable the DLC and all 7 story mods, `song_of_the_universe: true` and `required_friends: 9` will require you to reach the ends of the DLC and all 7 story mods before goaling.
- Added option groups. Since this is a custom game, mostly this means reordering and adding headers to the template/example .yamls, but you may also see these on alternate webhosts. 
- Universal Tracker nits:
	- In `shuffle_spacesuit: true` slots, Universal Tracker's `/next_progression` command should now be aware of the Spacesuit item
	- The Universal Tracker code can now handle missing options in slot_data. This probably has no impact today, but the next time we add a new logic-relevant option, it should allow UT with the latest OW apworld to just work on slots generated before the option was added.
	- Some dead code required by older Universal Tracker versions has been cleaned up (specifically the `interpret_slot_data` stub)

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Echo Hike story mod integration (thanks @aXu-AP ). The main appeal of this mod is the unique "Threader" item, which is a grapple beam/hook that works on any surface in the game.
	- `enable_eh_mod` option. When this is `true`, Threader use will be in-logic for:
		- Entering the BH Forge without a "warp path" to the Hanging City Ceiling
		- Climbing up into the bottom floor of GD tower rather than solving the Imaging Rule puzzles above
		- (if `enable_eote_dlc` is also `true`) Navigating The Stranger without rafts / Stranger Light Modulator
		- (if `enable_fc_mod` is also `true`) Reaching the Eye Signal Lab without the crystal puzzle
	- After receiving the "Threader" AP item, actual Threaders will be placed near all of your possible spawn points, including DLC and story mod systems.
	- 11 new AP locations (3 default, 8 logsanity) on the Echo Hike planet itself
- The "[Archipelago Hints]" option in NPC dialogue trees has been moved near the bottom, to reduce the risk of accidentally spending your hint by mashing through the dialogue (thanks aXu-AP)
- The custom loading spinner (with the 6 colored moons instead of 1 orange moon) has been fixed
- Previously, the "AP Console: Drop All AP Server Messages" setting would write AP server messages to the mod logs instead of the in-game console. Now, it won't write the messages anywhere at all. Hopefully this improves attempts to use this setting to mitigate instability in large multiworlds.
releases.bodyZh:
安装说明 [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation)。

- 回声徒步故事模组集成（感谢 @aXu-AP）。此模组的主要吸引力是独特的“Threader”物品，它是一种 grappling beam/hook，可在游戏的任何表面上使用。
	- `enable_eh_mod`选项。当此选项为`true`时，Threader的使用将在逻辑中：
		- 无需“跃迁路径”即可进入黑洞锻造室到达悬挂城天花板
		- 而不是解决成像法则谜题，直接爬上GD塔的底层
		- （如果`enable_eote_dlc`也为`true`）无需筏子/陌生人光调制器即可导航陌生人
		- （如果`enable_fc_mod`也为`true`）无需水晶谜题即可到达眼信号实验室
	- 获得Threader AP物品后，实际的Threaders将放置在您所有可能的出生点附近，包括DLC和故事模组系统。
	- 回声徒步行星本身有11个新的AP位置（3个默认，8个logsanity）。
- NPC对话树中的“[群岛提示]”选项已移至底部附近，以减少因快速点击对话而意外花费提示的风险（感谢aXu-AP）。
- 自定义加载动画（带有6个月亮而不是1个橙色月亮）已修复。
- 以前，“AP控制台：丢弃所有AP服务器消息”设置会将AP服务器消息写入模组日志而不是游戏内控制台。现在，它将完全不会写入任何消息。希望这能改善使用此设置来缓解大型多世界不稳定性的尝试。

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Fixed slots with Deep Bramble spawns spawning back on Timber Hearth after scanning certain FC signals or finishing the story of FC (thanks RS_Mind)
- Fixed `goal: echoes_of_the_eye` slots completing their goal by finishing the story of FC instead of EotE (thanks RS_Mind)
- In the in-game tracker, opening one of the checklist categories can now be done with the "interact" button as well as the "confirm" button (thanks aXu-AP)
- Hide the in-game AP console when accessing the ship log (thanks aXu-AP)
- Fixed the in-game tracker sometimes failing to update logic when AP server "cheats" in an item (thanks aXu-AP)
- dlc_only is meant to disable all story mods, but we forgot to make it disable FC as well. Now it does, which prevents fuzzer failures (thanks gerbiljames)

releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Forgotten Castaways story mod integration (thanks @msyverw and @rs_mind ) 
	- Adds an `enable_fc_mod` option, of course.
	- 13 new items. That includes 6 frequencies/signals, a "Translator (Deep Bramble)" if `split_translator: true`, and 6 custom items specific to Forgotten Castaways' progression.
	- 54 new default locations, and 118 new logsanity locations, for a total of 172 new locations. This raises the maximum possible location count for an Outer Wilds slot from 659 to 831.
	- And finally, a new spawn option: `deep_bramble`
- Fixed UT "go mode" so it actually checks your `goal` option, instead of incorrectly defaulting to `song_of_five` logic.
- Corrected item flag handling. I believe the only player-facing consequence is that now in-game hint text will correctly use the progression color for items which are both progression and useful.

releases.name: v0.3.20
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- From @t-rbernard: "Death Link Roulette" mod/client options, which can be used to randomly convert incoming death links into various trap item effects
- shuffle_spacesuit issues:
	- Fixed the ship's "Return Suit" prompt appearing and *working* even when you aren't wearing the suit. This bug allowed you to "take off" and then put on the suit without receiving the "Spacesuit" AP item.
	- Fixed the Spacesuit appearing in your ship (before receiving the "Spacesuit" AP item) when you warp into a New Horizons custom system
	- The warp to Sun Station is supposed to logically require Spacesuit, but due to a lambda capture bug (found by mysteryem's new fuzzer hook) it didn't in practice. This has now been fixed, so it's no longer theoretically possible for Spacesuit to get placed inside the Sun Station.
	- Somehow, the in-game tracker had an equivalent bug despite being completely different code, so it was not showing the "(Item: Spacesuit)" requirement on this connection. That's also fixed now.
- Fixed warping from a NewHorizons system back to the vanilla Outer Wilds system. Previously, this would often hang forever on the loading screen. (thanks msyverw / RS_Mind for pinning this down and prototyping a fix)
- Changed the implementation details of trap_type_weights and upgrade_counts so that:
	- The keys can now be omitted, with the same meaning as an explicit 0. For example, `trap_type_weights: { "Supernova Trap": 1 }` is valid now; no more listing 0s for all the other traps.
	- These options can now also be edited by AP's built-in "Options Creator" (and probably unofficial webhosts).
- Tweaked the tracker descriptions for Gabbro's Island 3 and 4 so they now explicitly say exactly how many loops are required to unlock these log facts
- Finally removed all of the [DEBUG] mod settings
- Fixed the `Location SLF__TH_VILLAGE_X3 is missing an AP id, so not sending anything to the AP server` warning

releases.name: v0.3.19
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- Fixed taking off the spacesuit in seeds where you wake up wearing it. This unbreaks a critical puzzle in one of the story mods, which we suspect was somehow broken by base game patch 16.
- Add a "AP Console: Drop All AP Server Messages" mod setting, partly because larger asyncs can be too spammy even with the existing filter setting, but also because we suspect excessive console messages are destabilizing Outer Wilds in general for some randomizer players.
- Worked around a bug that would break resuming a randomized expedition if an AP item with quotes in its name landed in that OW slot. Thanks Xayah for reporting this.
	- For what it's worth, the other AP game which exposed this bug was Paper Mario: TTYD. We don't know how many other games might be affected.
- Corrected tracker description for "HN2: Reading Room (Memory Cube)"; somehow it was a copy-paste of an unrelated HN1 location
- Corrected logic for "FQ Ship Log: Fret's Quest 4 - Reported" to be about translating the ritual recorder, not completing the entire song for Tuner
- Prevent death links being sent to/from a slot you're no longer playing by explicitly cleaning up the old deathlink service when switching slots.
- Tweak in-game hint text from "everywhere you've already been" to "everywhere you went before asking me for hints" to avoid implying that we're regenerating the hints every time you talk to the same traveler.
- Moved early_key_item implementation earlier to comply with Core AP PR #4481, hopefully fixing some subtle conflicts with start_inventory_from_pool and (non_)local_items.
- This won't affect players soon or directly, but I've added [the proposed apworld manifest](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/4516) to outer_wilds.apworld and used [the proposed apworld build tool](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/5340) to create it. This won't benefit players anytime soon, but hopefully it's a step towards a proper core AP toolchain for managing custom apworlds.

releases.name: v0.3.18
releases.body:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- A new `upgrade_counts` .yaml option from @msyverw that lets you change how many fuel, oxygen and boost upgrade items will be placed in the multiworld. Recall that the mod already has client-side settings for fuel/oxygen/boost.
- The five trap items added in 0.3.17 now have proper descriptions from @MYoshua64 and images for the AP Inventory ship log mode, which should get rid of those error messages some of you noticed.
- The Ice Physics Trap no longer affects the Dreamworld.
